summary.text: Doyle Lewis is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Madison Bolay in a race with no incumbent.
A retired oil field worker and U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he says his priorities include rural health care, vocational education and water security.

paragraphs.text: Lewis was born in Hayti, Missouri, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1973 to 1975; Ballotpedia lists his profession as retired.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired oil field worker who wants to be a conduit for the people of District 38.
He said his father died in a car accident when he was 4 years old and that his mother raised eight children on her own.
Lewis's Democratic primary was canceled, and he advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
He listed access to rural health care services, improving the vocational system and water security and management as his three campaign messages.
